name: North-pit shift (NearestDispatcher), legacy OpenMines
source: LEGACY optional generator, kept for cross-tool comparison (default samples now come from minehaulsim, issue #30): the MIT-licensed OpenMines simulator (github.com/370025263/openmines, arXiv:2404.00622), north_pit_mine.json config desensitized from the Huolinhe open-pit coal mine (Sept 2022). Single fixed mine layout, scalar-distance roads, no grades/rimpull, statistical congestion only.
caveats: Synthetic cycle log (structure-real): no ground-truthed open-pit FMS dispatch log is public (verified 2026-07-01). Coal-mine config; domain-transfer caveat vs Cu open-pit.
